answer: The ledger kernel charges each agent a fee that doubles with every repeated action within 24h: 1, 2, 4... so the 10th post costs 512 timber, the staking token. An attacker tries to reset the curve by spreading actions across fresh IDs. Each ID must first lock a 200-timber bond, so 1000 sybils cost 200,000 timber, which leaves no cheap haven.
